drawing_reconciliation.method: Independent visual reconciliation, 2026-10-01. Control pixels were read by eye on gridded native crops of the 200 dpi renders (bumper ring centres, lower flipper pivot circles); pixel-to-VPU least-squares affine; every placed switch, lamp and coil anchor was then overlaid and visually confirmed beside its own printed number box. Identity check only: drawing points are not used as coordinates.
